modules.name: Card Workshop
modules.summary: Independent games, shared presentation utilities, and dedicated workbenches. Enter a module to explore its responsibilities and source evidence.

modules.name: Workshop shell
modules.summary: Chooses the active game and lazily opens game and art workbenches. Owns navigation, not game rules.

modules.name: Game systems
modules.summary: Each game owns its content, authoritative rules and saved sessions. Browser UI submits commands.

modules.name: Shared utilities
modules.summary: Small proven utilities for seeded randomness, replay, playback and deterministic layouts. No universal game engine.

modules.name: Art workbench
modules.summary: Blender authoring and asset delivery, with its own source, export and verification pipeline.

modules.name: Repository tools
modules.summary: Maintenance gates, experiment runners and evidence processing. Session review is a separate presentation package.

modules.name: Repo Canvas
modules.summary: Shared architecture interface inside Codex: an isolated document model, repository bridge and MCP App with discussion in the current conversation.

modules.name: Blindside
modules.summary: Poker hands, blinds, jokers and shop progression in an independent seeded game.

modules.name: Slay the Spire
modules.summary: Deckbuilding runs with character content, combat commands and validated session persistence.

modules.name: Last Hearth
modules.summary: Tavern recruitment and automatic combat own distinct timing and command rules.

modules.name: Emberwake
modules.summary: Action RPG with content, world rules, application persistence and its own UI package.

modules.name: Dungeon Cartographer
modules.summary: A playable map study using shared deterministic room geometry.

modules.name: Night Passage
modules.summary: A separately loaded game surface with dedicated rules and presentation.

modules.name: Presentation
modules.summary: Displays run state and submits player commands.

modules.name: Session
modules.summary: Persists and reconstructs validated runs and replays.

modules.name: Rules & content
modules.summary: Owns legal transitions, combat and rewards.

modules.name: Trace normalization
modules.summary: Normalizes local session evidence and produces review documents.

modules.name: Session review
modules.summary: Shared frontend for offline exports and local session review.

modules.name: Maintenance governance
modules.summary: Enforces source checker scope, document placement and artifact retention contracts.

modules.name: Canvas & inspector
modules.summary: Renders the current hierarchy scope, projected relationships and source overlays. Changes remain drafts until saved.

modules.name: Architecture document
modules.summary: One versioned document shared with the agent. Validates hierarchy, IDs, endpoints, annotations and layout.

modules.name: Repository bridge
modules.summary: Loads and saves the shared file with revision checks; previews bounded repo source.

modules.name: Codex side-chat plugin
modules.summary: Hosted MCP App sends user messages to the owning Codex conversation. The chat reads captured context and returns replies and map proposals for review; no separate agent runs.

annotations.text: Initial curated orientation based on AGENTS.md, package declarations and inspected entry points. Relationships are a selected architectural view, not a complete import graph.
annotations.author: agent

annotations.text: Side chat captures unsaved map context for the current Codex conversation. Review proposals, apply to draft, then save. Direct external file edits appear automatically when the local draft is clean.
annotations.author: agent
